locator: I q.2 a.3 co., secunda via: in omnibus causis efficientibus ordinatis, primum est causa medii, et medium est causa ultimi
interpretation: Reading B (weaker), parallel to the prima via's AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-SECOND-MOVERS-B: a cause is a middle cause only when its being caused bears on its causing this effect ('remota causa, removetur effectus' read per the relevant respect; cf. ST I q.46 a.2 ad 7 reading B, 'generat enim inquantum homo'). On this reading the second way yields at most a cause uncaused in the respects relevant to its causing, not one caused by nothing. Not used by any result yet; the analogue of #151's relative result and interpretive argument is candidate AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-SECUNDA-VIA-REMAINING.
